## Why visit

A distinctive tiled basement with a particularly compelling combination of Pomona Island cask and a documented Little Pomona cider line. The small entrance is easy to miss; downstairs, the glazed-brick room supplies atmosphere without pretending to be an untouched old pub. This is one of the most useful cider-led choices in central Manchester and a logical link between the city-centre venues and Salford. It suits a deliberate stop to ask what is pouring and compare beer with a more characterful cider.

## Beer

CAMRA documents four changing cask lines, commonly including Pomona Island and other smaller breweries. Pomona Island is a recurring changing-cask supplier here, alongside smaller guest brewers.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly identifies a permanent Little Pomona real-cider line. Confirm the actual cider and any bottle alternatives on the day.

## Plan the visit

Basement stairs and no accessible toilet are documented. Card only. Monday and Tuesday opening is later than lunchtime in the current listing.

**Getting there:** Walk from Salford Central or across from central Manchester; pairs naturally with the New Oxford.
